title: Comic
look: Bold ink line, Ben-Day dots and a sunburst behind, like a comic panel.

doc.essence: A pulp comic panel: saturated colour printed with Ben-Day dots, a heavy ink line, a sunburst.
doc.notIt: Not ink (dots and burst), not riso (black line, saturated process colour).
doc.shapes: Heavy black outline pass. Squarer corners, thicker limbs that thin towards the hands.
doc.colour: Saturated +25 %, darker dots over each area.
doc.eyes: White ovals with a black pupil that looks around, a heavy upper lid and bold slab brows.
doc.motion: Smooth, with springs loose enough to overshoot and settle.
